1.title: Exam Technique and Final Review
1.text: Welcome to Module seventeen: Exam Technique and Final Review. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do five things. Technique. The command chooser. Look-alike pairs. Five questions to ask in every scenario. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Scope: All objectives: time plan, command chooser, look-alike terms and decision rules. Exam format: a one-hour online-proctored multiple-choice exam on Terraform one point one two. Validated against: the official Terraform Associate version oh oh four exam objectives.

1.title: Technique
1.text: Technique. Time. One hour: keep a steady pace and mark hard questions. Read the last line. Is it a command, a block, a file or a behavior? Safe defaults. Plan before apply, state is sensitive, never edit state by hand, pin versions. Eliminate. Remove answers with the wrong command or the wrong block. Provider details. Not tested; ignore cloud-specific names. Never blank. Answer every question. Exam tip: The exam tests what a command or block does and when to use it. Learn each one in a sentence.

1.title: The command chooser
1.text: The command chooser. Prepare a directory. terraform init ( -upgrade for newer providers). Check configuration. terraform validate. Fix style. terraform fmt. Preview changes. terraform plan ( -out to save). Make changes. terraform apply. Remove everything. terraform destroy. Recreate one resource. terraform apply -replace A D D R E S S. Accept real values into state. terraform apply -refresh only. Adopt an existing object. import block or terraform import. List or inspect state. terraform state list, state show.

1.title: The command chooser, continued
1.text: The command chooser. Forget without destroying. removed block with destroy false or terraform state rm. Rename without recreating. moved block. Show outputs. terraform output. Test an expression. terraform console. Release a stuck lock. terraform force unlock. Authenticate to H C P Terraform. terraform login. Debug. T F L O G and T F L O G P A T H.

1.title: Look-alike pairs
1.text: Look-alike pairs. resource and data. Manage and read. variable, local, output. Input, internal name, result. count and for each. Number and map or set (stable keys). list, set, map, object. Ordered, unique, keys and values, named attributes. Implicit and explicit dependency. Reference and depends on. precondition, postcondition, check, validation. Before, after, warning, input. Sensitive, ephemeral, write-only. Hidden in output, never saved, accepts ephemeral and is not stored.

1.title: Look-alike pairs, continued
1.text: Look-alike pairs. moved and removed. Rename and forget. Local backend and remote backend. File on disk and shared, locked storage. C L I workspace and H C P Terraform workspace. Another state in one directory and a full environment. Drift and refresh-only. Outside change and update state to match. - or plus replace orders. - or plus destroy first, plus or - create first.

1.title: Five questions to ask in every scenario
1.text: Five questions to ask in every scenario. Is this about configuration, state or workflow? Finds the objective group. Does the command change infrastructure, state, or neither? plan neither, apply both, -refresh only state only. Is a secret involved? State and plan files hold it. Is it for one person or a team? Team equals remote backend, locking, H C P Terraform. What is the safest, simplest answer? The exam favors built-in features. Exam tip: If two answers fit, pick the one that does not touch real infrastructure or state unless the question asks for it. Exam tip: Read the last line of the question first. It tells you whether the answer is a command, a block, a file or a behavior.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. Which command would you run first in a new directory that contains configuration? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: terraform init. terraform init installs providers and modules and prepares the backend.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. Which block creates several resources from a set of names with stable keys? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: for each. for each uses map keys or set values, so removing one item does not renumber the others.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. A secret must never be written to the state. Which approach helps? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Using an ephemeral value with a write-only argument. Ephemeral values and write-only arguments are not saved in the plan or state.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. What does terraform plan do to real infrastructure? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: It changes nothing. A plan only shows what would change.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. A resource was renamed in the configuration and must not be recreated. What should be added? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: A moved block. A moved block updates the address in the state without recreating the object.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. Which feature lets several workspaces share the same variables in H C P Terraform? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Variable sets. Variable sets are reusable groups of variables applied to many workspaces or projects.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. How long is the exam? Answer: One hour. Question two. Which command prepares the working directory? Answer: terraform init. Question three. Which command updates only the state to match reality? Answer: terraform apply -refresh-only.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. Which block renames without recreating? Answer: moved. Question five. Which values are never saved in state? Answer: Ephemeral values. Question six. What groups workspaces in H C P Terraform? Answer: A project.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Method: group, eliminate, safe defaults, simplest built-in answer. Commands: init, validate, fmt, plan, apply, destroy, -replace, -refresh-only, import, state, console, login. Look-alikes: resource or data, count or for each, moved or removed, sensitive or ephemeral or write-only, C L I or H C P workspaces. Defaults: plan before apply; protect state; pin versions; remote backend for teams. If this course is helping you, please subscribe to the channel and hit the bell icon, so you get a notification when the next video is out. That completes the course. Good luck with the exam.
